title: The deal entity is sued
summary: Calendar the answer deadline, notify insurers, preserve documents and engage counsel.

situation.trigger: The deal entity is served with a lawsuit.

outlineSteps: Record the date and manner of service
Send the suit to every insurer that may cover it
Preserve documents, emails and files tied to the claim
Tell the lender if the loan requires notice of litigation
Assess the claim and the exposure with counsel
Tell investors and record the suit and its status
